feedback_driven.quote: Online self-improvement converts intermediate solver failures into reusable skills during generation.

persists_across_tasks.quote: Post-task self-improvement revises skills, prompts, and workflows after each batch, adopting candidates only when they generate harder valid tasks within a bounded cost increase.

data.why_zh: 摘要明确改写技能、提示与工作流，模型权重冻结，跨轮采纳保留，构成 Harness 演化。
